DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_id as "id", ini_incident_state_id as "iniIncidentStateId", incident_group_id as "incidentGroupId", incident_level_id as "incidentLevelId", default_user_id as "defaultUserId", alias as "alias", description as "description", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_types WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_types (incident_type_id, ini_incident_state_id, incident_group_id, incident_level_id, default_user_id, alias, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.ims_incident_types'$'incident_type_id'}, :iniIncidentStateId, :incidentGroupId, :incidentLevelId, :defaultUserId, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_types SET ini_incident_state_id = :iniIncidentStateId, incident_group_id = :incidentGroupId, incident_level_id = :incidentLevelId, default_user_id = :defaultUserId, alias = :alias, description = :description, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_id = :id
